title: J. Andrew Kissner's 1994-95 interviews with legacy program insiders

tellings.quote: >> And so in 1994, 1995, he conducted a series of interviews with firsthand legacy people all across the board.

plain: In 1994 and 1995 a man named J. Andrew Kissner carried out a series of interviews with firsthand "legacy" people, insiders of the secret programme said to have handled crashed UFO material since 1947, across the board. The pseudonymous online researcher UAPGerb tells Michels this without naming a source; if true, those interviews would be a rare record from people who worked inside the programme.
